create.name: Fleur Chambers
create.bio:
Fleur Chambers is an Australian meditation teacher and author, and the creator of The Happy Habit, which brings together a meditation app, short online courses and illustrated self-help books. She says her offerings have been downloaded more than four million times across 45 countries.

Her approach grew out of about ten years of living with chronic pain. Told there was no medical answer for her condition, she chose to look for what the pain could teach her, and she now argues that happiness is not a life without discomfort but the ability to stay connected to yourself while it is there. Much of her recent teaching is framed around the nervous system: small practices for the moments when stress, guilt or overwhelm actually arrive, rather than long sessions of stillness.

Her courses include twenty micro-meditations for everyday moments, seven guided walking meditations, and a short programme for people who habitually give too much. She has written two books, Ten Pathways and Wholehearted Confidence. In 2022 The Happy Habit became a social enterprise that gives half its profits to grassroots projects in clean water, climate action and education, and she reports that it has helped fund clean drinking water for some 80,000 people. She is also the mother of three teenage sons.

healer.no_public_base: Her site names no town; it is a .com.au site with prices in AUD and an Acknowledgement of Country, so country Australia. An earlier plan said Melbourne but no source on her current pages states it.

books.title: Ten Pathways: Discover Inner Happiness and Transform Your Life
books.author: Fleur Chambers
books.description: An illustrated guide to ten ways of finding a steadier kind of happiness, drawn from her own decade with chronic pain and from meditation practice.

books.title: Wholehearted Confidence: Live, Love and Contribute
books.author: Fleur Chambers
books.description: Treats confidence as self-trust rather than something to be earned, with gentle practices for questioning old stories and feeling more at ease in one's own skin.

courses.title: The Happy Habit app (full subscription)
courses.description: Her meditation app, free to download, with a paid tier that opens hundreds of guided meditations, short challenges, music, journaling exercises, sleep and focus tracks, and courses.

courses.title: In the Moment
courses.description: Twenty audio micro-meditations, each under seven minutes, for the moments in a day when stress, regret, restlessness or a racing mind show up.

courses.title: Walk Yourself Home
courses.description: Seven guided walking meditations of under twenty minutes each, every one paired with a question to reflect on while you walk.

courses.title: The Overgiver's Reset
courses.description: Five short practices for people who habitually say yes and look after everyone else, aimed at noticing the reflex in the body before it takes over.

free_resources.title: Nervous System Reset (free guided meditation)
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation for settling the body during a busy season, streamed on the page.
